title: Lupiwighteone exerts anti-aging effects by suppressing NF-kappaB and activating the MAPKs/Nrf2 signaling pathway.
authors: Hu, Kun; Ge, Ge; Wu, Bingjian; Yang, Jia; Ren, Jie; Zhang, Lirong
journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Toxicology & pharmacology : CBP
one_liner_zh: 研究天然化合物Lupiwighteone的抗炎抗衰老作用，涉及NF-kappaB和MAPKs/Nrf2通路，仅用分子对接辅助，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Lupiwighteone (Lup), a natural isoflavonoid, phytochemical, exhibits potential anti-inflammatory properties; however, its impacts on inflammation, oxidative stress, and aging processes remain insufficiently characterized. The present study systematically investigated the anti-inflammatory and anti-aging effects of Lup using lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages and Caenorhabditis elegans (C. elegans), aiming to elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms and biological significance. The study employed cell culture, animal experiments, and molecular biology techniques, combined with molecular docking, to evaluate Lup's modulatory effects on NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling cascades and the Nrf2 pathway. Our results indicated that Lup treatment significantly extended lifespan, reduced reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, and slowed age-related physiological decline in the C. elegans model. Mechanistically, we found that Lup activated the MAPKs/Nrf2 pathway, enhanced antioxidant stress responses, and reduced oxidative damage, thereby delaying the aging process. Additionally, Lup treatment significantly suppressed the production and secretion of key pro-inflammatory mediators, including TNF-alpha, IL-6, and nitric oxide, while inhibiting NF-kappaB signaling activation in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells. This inhibition was mediated by impeding IkappaBalpha degradation, thereby preventing NF-kappaB translocation to the nucleus. Collectively, these findings demonstrated that Lup exerts significant anti-aging, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities through the dual regulation of oxidative stress and inflammation. These results not only strengthen the theoretical basis of plant-derived medicines in anti-inflammation and anti-aging but also provide new insights and practical guidance for the future development of natural pharmaceuticals.
abstract_zh: Lupiwighteone（Lup）是一种天然异黄酮类植物化学物，具有潜在的抗炎特性；然而，其对炎症、氧化应激及衰老过程的影响仍未得到充分表征。本研究利用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞和秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）系统研究了Lup的抗炎和抗衰老作用，旨在阐明其潜在的分子机制和生物学意义。研究采用细胞培养、动物实验和分子生物学技术，结合分子对接，评估了Lup对NF-kappaB和MAPK信号级联及Nrf2通路的调节作用。结果表明，Lup处理显著延长了C. elegans模型的寿命，降低了活性氧（ROS）水平，并减缓了与年龄相关的生理衰退。机制上，我们发现Lup激活了MAPKs/Nrf2通路，增强了抗氧化应激反应，减少了氧化损伤，从而延缓了衰老过程。此外，Lup处理显著抑制了关键促炎介质（包括TNF-alpha、IL-6和一氧化氮）的产生和分泌，同时抑制了LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞中NF-kappaB信号的激活。这种抑制作用通过阻碍IkappaBalpha降解实现，从而阻止NF-kappaB向细胞核转位。综合来看，这些发现表明Lup通过对氧化应激和炎症的双重调节，发挥了显著的抗衰老、抗炎和抗氧化活性。这些结果不仅强化了植物源药物在抗炎和抗衰老方面的理论基础，也为未来天然药物的开发提供了新的见解和实践指导。
